user.title: Connect to your BluOS player
user.description: Enter the IP address of your BluOS player (amplifier, streamer...).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to a BluOS player at this address.

init.title: Services shown in the panel
init.description: Hide the services you do not use, for example a music service you have no account for. They stay available in the BluOS app. The maximum volume applies to Home Assistant (panel, cards, services), not to the BluOS app or the remote.

data.backup_playlists: Back up the playlists of this player

backup_playlists.name: Save the playlists as text files now
backup_playlists.description: Writes the playlists saved on the players as text files (.m3u8) in the bluos_companion/playlists folder of the Home Assistant configuration. This also happens before every Home Assistant backup, which then contains them.
